title: CI workflows: draft PR state no longer gates any job; PR job skips now come from event, label, author or closed-action checks
answers: Do CI jobs run on draft pull requests in MLflow?
Where is the draft-PR handling for GitHub Actions jobs?
Why does the labeling or patch job run on draft PRs now?
Which CI jobs still get skipped on a pull request?
body:
Path: job-level `if:` conditions across .github/workflows. Jobs in build-wheel.yml, docs.yml, js.yml, lint.yml, master.yml, protobuf-cross-test.yml, protos.yml, tracing.yml, typescript.yml, labeling.yml and patch.yml have no draft check. Chokepoints that still gate PR runs: the pull_request alternatives in examples.yml, r.yml, slow-tests.yml, test-requirements.yml, uc-oss.yml and cross-version-tests.yml (`set-matrix`); `github.event.action != 'closed'` in release-note.yml (`validate-labeled`); and the `ui-preview` label plus author check (OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR or the Copilot bot) in ui-preview.yml.
Rule: Draft state is not a gate anywhere in these workflows, so draft and ready PRs run the same jobs. Jobs without an `if:` run on every pull_request event. No `ready_for_review` trigger was added, because pull_request events already fire for drafts. Disabled jobs stay disabled with a literal `if: false` (fs2db.yml), not with a dead predicate.
Symptom: (omitted for a map.) Before the change, Phase 1 draft gates skipped these jobs on draft PRs, so a draft showed no checks for them.
Constraints: To find why a PR job did not run, check event-name alternatives, labels, author association and action, not draft. Copilot lifecycle and authorization workflows were left unchanged. Does not cover push, schedule or workflow_dispatch triggers.
applies: Where CI job gating is decided for pull requests in .github/workflows, after the Phase 1 draft-gate removal.
says: Why do draft pull requests still run CI jobs like labeling or patch now?
Which CI checks still get skipped on a pull request, and based on what?
Draft PRs show the same checks as ready PRs; is that intended for MLflow?
Why is a CI job missing on my pull request, and which label or author rule causes it?
search: CI job gating for pull requests after draft-state gates were removed: draft and ready PRs run the same jobs. Jobs skip only on event-name alternatives, the ui-preview label and author check, or the release-note closed action. Disabled jobs use a literal if: false.
